fighter.question1: I want to participate in an event. How do I do that?
fighter.answer1:
All fights go through a voting process exclusively for our Fans. There are three ways to be included in the voting process:
1. Fans4 admins nominate you
2. You apply for a fight with another Fighter
3. Your fans nominate you through the app
fighter.question2: Can I choose an opponent if I apply for a fight?
fighter.answer2:
Yes! A unique feature on Fans4 is that you can request a fight against another Fans4 Fighter. To 'Apply for a Fight':
1. Select a Fighter from the Fighters page
2. Open their profile
3. Click on ‘Apply for a Fight'
4. Your request will be sent to a Fans4 admin.
Note that you can only select a Fighter in which:
- your weight classes are the same
- you are in the same category
- your opponent is in 'Ready for Fights' status
fighter.question3: How can I start earning money?
fighter.answer3: Fans4 is the only platform to offer financial reward to our Fighters. You will receive money for every Fan that subscribes to your Fans4 page. Be sure to invite followers who will support you via your own personalised QR code found in the app (Profile > Settings > Invite a Fan > scan the QR code). Be an active user on our app, post quality content, apply for fights and participate in events so Fans stay tuned to your content.
fighter.answer4: You will need to add your bank account details in order to receive payment. Go to Profile > Settings > Finances > Add bank account and follow the instructions. The more Fans you have, the more you earn!

fan.question1: Why are some features not available to me?
fan.answer1: Some features are only available with a subscription to Fans4. For example, viewing all Fighter exclusive content or proposing a fight between your Fighters is only available once you are subscribed to at least one Fighter.
fan.question2: When can I start pairing and voting for my Fighter?
fan.answer2: Playing matchmaker is a very unique and exciting feature of the Fans4 app. Very soon you will enjoy added features and functionality on Fans4!
fan.question3: When is the next live event and how to I watch it?
fan.answer3: We are planning for a Fans4 event in the first quarter of 2022. Stay tuned for more details including live streaming options.
fan.question4: How can I propose a fight?
fan.answer4: You can propose a fight only with the Fighters who you are subscribed to. To do this, go to Voting > Propose > Choose your Fighter > Next > Choose opponent > Submit. Once approved, you will be able to vote your Fighter in for the next event. Be sure to track the proposal status on 'Your Proposals' tab on the Voting page.
